title: Denis Carey
html_source: Bloom mistakes the first name of James Carey. Denis Carey was an exceptional all-round Irish athlete and world champion hammer thrower. Carey won the hammer at the AAA Championships in 1893, placed third in the pole vault in 1897, and was a finalist in the 120y hurdles in 1902. At home he won the Irish AAA hammer title six times (1892-3, 1907, 1910, 1913-14), the 120y hurdles five times (1898-1901, 1905), and the pole vault in 1893.
